I couldn't deploy: this session has no shell (Bash is disabled and I have no PowerShell or sf deploy tool), and the sf-context server is read-only. The code is written locally but nothing is in the org, and none of the tests have been run.

**What I changed**
- `AccountService.cls`: I added `validateAnnualRevenue(List<Account>)`. It calls `addError('Annual Revenue cannot be negative.')` on `AnnualRevenue` when the value is below 0. Null and zero are allowed.
- `AccountTriggerHandler.cls`: `beforeInsert` and `beforeUpdate` now call the new validation before the duplicate check. Existing method signatures are unchanged, so `AccountTrigger` and the existing callers still work. The `bypassTrigger` flag also skips the new validation.
- `AccountAnnualRevenue_Test.cls` (new, with its meta.xml at API 62.0): It has five tests covering negative revenue on insert and on update, allowed values (zero, null, positive), a mixed bulk insert, and the bypass flag.

**Conventions followed:** This org's Account handler is a static handler that delegates to `AccountService`. It doesn't use the `TriggerHandler` base class from the knowledge base, so I didn't introduce one. I also kept the single existing `AccountTrigger`, and the test class follows the existing `*_Test` naming.

**To deploy, run this from the project root:**
```
sf project deploy start --source-dir force-app/main/default/classes --test-level RunSpecifiedTests --tests AccountAnnualRevenue_Test --tests AccountTriggerHandler_Test --tests AccountTrigger_Test --tests AccountService_Test
```
